entities.summary: The Predynastic Zhou or Proto-Zhou refers to the ancient Chinese state ruled by the Ji clan that existed in the Guanzhong region during the Shang dynasty, before its rebellion and subsequent conquest of the Shang in 1046-1045 BC led to the establishment of the Zhou dynasty. According to histories, predynastic Zhou rose as a western frontier vassal state of the Shang, acting as its ally against the Xirong barbarians until their influence surpassed that of the Shang dynasty.
